notes: All integers are 32-byte big-endian hex. Points are 48-byte compressed G1. spend_tweak is (t_k + label_scalar) mod r.

payments.name: vector_2_two_recipients
payments.description: One input, two recipients with different scan keys.

payments.name: vector_3_labeled
payments.description: One input, one output to a labeled address (m = 1).

payments.name: vector_4_multi_input
payments.description: Two inputs bound by a 2-cycle of ASSERT_CONCURRENT_SPEND conditions.

payments.name: vector_6_two_outputs_one_recipient
payments.description: The transaction of vector 1 with the same recipient listed twice (k = 0, 1).

payments.name: vector_7_change_label
payments.description: One input, one change output to the recipient's own label m = 0.

payments.name: vector_9_cat_payment
payments.description: One CAT coin spent alone pays one unlabeled output in its asset.

payments.name: vector_10_mixed_xch_cat_group
payments.description: An XCH coin and a CAT coin bound by a 2-cycle of ASSERT_CONCURRENT_SPEND conditions form one spend group; one output in the CAT (k = 0) and one in XCH (k = 1) to one recipient.

payments.name: vector_11_revocable_cat
payments.description: One revocable CAT coin (CHIP-0038) spent on the holder's path pays one output that keeps the revocation layer.

settlement_payments.name: vector_12_maker_silent_offer
settlement_payments.description: The maker offers XCH from two coins bound in a cycle and requests a CAT; the CAT payment is derived at k = 0 and paid through the CAT settlement coin, the XCH change at k = 1 with label 0.

settlement_payments.name: vector_13_taker_silent_offer
settlement_payments.description: The taker gives a CAT from one coin and is paid XCH at k = 0 through the XCH settlement coin; its CAT change is at k = 1 with label 0.
